radians(longitude)) + sin(radians(latitude)) * sin(radians(#{latitude})) )) AS distance from talk t left join tb_user u on u.user_id=t.user_id left join vip v on v.vip_index=u.vip_index where u.user_id is not null and t.is_delete is null

and t.talk_id in (select talk_id from good_talk where user_id=#{goodUserId})

and t.content like concat('%',#{content},'%')

SELECT t.talk_id as talkId, t.status, u.user_name as nickName, u.avatar as imageUrl, t.is_delete as isDelete, t.audit_content as auditContent, t.create_time as createTime, t.content, t.img, t.share_num as shareNum, t.user_id as userId, t.video_url as videoUrl, t.activity_id as activityId, u.sex, u.consortia_id as consortiaId, t.address, t.longitude, t.latitude, u.age, t.city, t.province, t.district, t.good_num as goodNum, t.is_recommend as isRecommend, t.popular_value as popularValue, t.group_plan_id as groupPlanId, (select count(*) from talk_comment c where c.talk_id=t.talk_id and c.is_delete is null) as commentCount,t.admin_browse_count as adminBrowseCount, (select count(*) from talk_reward c where c.talk_id=t.talk_id) as rewardCount, (select ifnull(sum(content),0) from message_info c where c.platform_id=t.talk_id and c.state=120)+ifnull(admin_browse_count,0) as browseCount, (select count(*)+ifnull(t.good_num,0) from good_talk c where c.talk_id=t.talk_id) as goodTalkCount, (select count(*) from good_talk c where c.talk_id=t.talk_id) as goodCount, (select count(*) from talk_comment c where c.talk_id=t.talk_id and c.user_id=#{byUserId} and c.is_delete is null) as commentByUserCount, (select count(*) from good_talk c where c.talk_id=t.talk_id and c.user_id=#{byUserId}) as goodTalkByUserCount, (select count(*) from talk_reward c where c.talk_id=t.talk_id and c.user_id=#{byUserId}) as rewardByUserCount, (select count(*) from user_follow c where c.follow_user_id=t.user_id and c.user_id=#{byUserId}) as followCount FROM talk t left join tb_user u on t.user_id=u.user_id where u.user_id is not null and t.is_delete is null
and t.content LIKE concat ('%',#{content},'%')
and t.status = '2' order by t.popular_value DESC
